land.text: Ronda, once 'the Córdoba caliphate broke up'

predecessors.note: The Ronda page gives no year for the break-up; the infobox gives 1039 for the taifa.

land.text: the whole taifa, conquered by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid in 1065

rulers.name: Badis ibn Hilal
rulers.note: Page: 1053/4-1057/8; the page also lists 'Abu Nur Hilal (restored)' from 1057/8 with no end date.

correction.text: the same shape (5 cells, 1,142 km2) from 1039, when the taifa was 'established', to 1055

keyframe_review.note: Only the start changes: the infobox says 'Established: 1039' and the text 'It existed from 1039 to 1065'; Cliopatria starts in 1040. The page gives no area or boundary (page silent), so the 1,142 km2 (the Sierra de Ronda around the capital) is Cliopatria's. Its neighbours Algeciras, Arcos, Carmona and Morón (1040-1065) and Seville (from 1056) are not described on the pages opened.

The same 5 cells as 1040-1055, to 1065: 'Conquered by the Taifa of Seville: 1065' (infobox) and 'In 1065, Ronda was conquered by the taifa of Seville led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid' (Ronda page). Cliopatria's Seville shape holds the cells from 1066 on the grid, not 1065.

ledger.note: 1039: the taifa of Ronda is established under the Berber Banu Ifran. Infobox 'Established: 1039'; 'a family from the Berber Banu Ifran tribe of North Africa'; the Ronda page: 'Ronda became the capital of a small kingdom ruled by the Berber Banu Ifran' once the Córdoba caliphate broke up (no year). The page gives no boundary.

region.text: Ronda and the Sierra de Ronda, the capital of a small kingdom

ledger.note: 1065: Seville conquers Ronda. 'Conquered by the Taifa of Seville: 1065'; 'From 1065 until 1091, the taifa was under the control of the Taifa of Seville' under Abbad II al-Mu'tadid (Taifa of Ronda page); the Ronda page: 'In 1065, Ronda was conquered by the taifa of Seville led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid'.
1065: the taifa of Ronda ends with Abbad II's conquest ('It existed from 1039 to 1065').

wars.name: Seville's conquest of the taifa of Ronda
wars.outcome: Seville under Abbad II al-Mu'tadid conquered Ronda in 1065 and held it until 1091.
wars.note: No campaign or battle is dated on the pages opened; the Seville page lists Ronda neither among Abbad II's conquests nor with a year (page silent).

certainty.note: A small Berber taifa around Ronda; the pages give no frontier.

sources.title: Taifa of Ronda
sources.note: Infobox (capital Ronda, established 1039, conquered by Seville 1065), the Banu Ifran, rulers 1039-1065; silent on area and extent.

sources.title: Ronda
sources.note: Confirms 'In 1065, Ronda was conquered by the taifa of Seville led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid'; silent on founding, rulers and extent.

notes: Two Cliopatria shapes of the same 5 cells (1040-1055, 1056-1065); the pages (Taifa of Ronda, Ronda) give 1039 for the founding and 1065 for the conquest by Seville and are silent on area, boundaries and every neighbour, so the only change to Cliopatria is the one year at the start. Not settled (page silent): the extent of the taifa; the 1039/40 break with the Córdoba caliphate; the rulers' full names (the page lists 'Abu Nour', 'Badis ibn Hilal', 'Abu Nur Hilal (restored)', 'Abu Nars Fatuh' with half-year dates); Almoravid dealings with Ronda after 1091 (page silent); the neighbours Algeciras, Arcos, Carmona, Morón (1040-1065) in Cliopatria. Counterparts: caliphate-of-cordoba and taifa-of-seville are other eu-12 parts. Gazetteer name needed: Ronda (place), real town, 36.74 N 5.17 W. Page budget (1-2): Taifa of Ronda, Ronda.
